title: brunfelsia macrantha
intro: Brunfelsia macrantha, commonly known as the Yarumo or Esoesne, is a flowering plant species in the Brunfelsia genus, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety and stress, due to its calming effects and potential therapeutic actions, which include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Brunfelsia macrantha include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Brunfelsia macrantha include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of depression.
